start.title: A New Star
start.text:
A bright star rises in the east.
It shines unlike any other.

choices.feedback: Matthew 2:2 — The wise men came to Jerusalem asking where the one who has been born king of the Jews was, for they had seen his star in the east and had come to worship him.
It is a sign of joy, not dread.

ignore_consequence.title: Look Again
ignore_consequence.text:
The star will not be hidden.
It calls you onward.

fear_consequence.title: Take Heart
fear_consequence.text:
This light brings hope.
Follow where it leads.

journey.title: The Long Road
journey.text:
You ride west across endless dunes.
The star moves before you.

choices.text: Turn back, the road is hard

choices.feedback: Matthew 2:9 — After they had heard the king, they went on their way, and the star they had seen in the east went ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
A king must dwell with kings.

turn_back_consequence.title: Forward Still
turn_back_consequence.text:
The promise lies ahead.
Do not turn from it now.

herod.title: Before Herod
herod.text:
"Where is the newborn King of the Jews?"
Herod's eyes grow cold.

choices.feedback: Matthew 2:4-6 — Herod called together all the people’s chief priests and teachers of the law, and he asked them where the Messiah was to be born. They told him, “In Bethlehem in Judea, for this is what the prophet has written: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah; for out of you will come a ruler who will shepherd my people Israel.’”

loyalty_consequence.title: One True King
loyalty_consequence.text:
Herod is not the One you seek.
Keep your eyes on the star.

bethlehem.title: The Star Stops
bethlehem.text:
The star halts above a humble house.
Here, the King is found.

choices.text: Doubt — this cannot be the place

choices.feedback: Matthew 2:11 — On coming to the house, they saw the child with his mother Mary, and they bowed down and worshiped him.

doubt_consequence.title: Trust the Sign
doubt_consequence.text:
The star itself has led you here.
Believe and enter.

choices.feedback: You step inside the warm light.

wait_consequence.title: Enter Now
wait_consequence.text:
Do not delay before the King.
He waits within.

worship.title: Gold, Frankincense, Myrrh
worship.text:
The child meets your eyes.
You kneel and open your treasures.

choices.text: Keep the finest gifts for yourself
Offer all three gifts to the child
choices.feedback: Matthew 2:11 — Then they opened their treasures and presented him with gifts of gold, frankincense and myrrh.

greed_consequence.title: Give All
greed_consequence.text:
He is the King of kings.
Hold nothing back.

choices.text: Offer all three gifts to the child
choices.feedback: You place each gift before him.

dream.title: A Warning in Sleep
dream.text:
In a dream you are warned:
"Do not return to Herod."

choices.feedback: Matthew 2:12 — And having been warned in a dream not to go back to Herod, they returned to their country by another route.

betray_consequence.title: Obey the Dream
betray_consequence.text:
Herod plots against the child.
Do not lead him to the King.

stay_consequence.title: Go Home
stay_consequence.text:
Your task here is fulfilled.
Return by another way.

choices.feedback: You set out at first light.

return.title: Another Road
return.text:
You ride east as dawn breaks.
You have seen the King.
